messages.text:
<@U02GQL9QG9G> Updates on OpsGuru:

After carefully weighing the underlying factors, including deadlines, required effort, and the margin for error, we feel that moving forward with OpsGuru at this stage would not deliver enough platform value to justify the cost.

Instead, we’ll use the next two weeks to close out remaining loose ends, build the core APIs that power the app, and stabilize the user experience. By October 31st, we’ll have a leaner version of those APIs ready for launch - not highly sophisticated yet, but stable and reliable enough to support our marketing efforts and creator onboarding.

The development efforts continue post 31st. We'll progressively enhance the system's sophistication and performance. Our initial corpus of videos will be small (even with each creator uploading tens of videos and regular daily uploads), users will experience a smooth and responsive product which gets better over time as we build more complexity behind the scenes.

Looking ahead, we can revisit engaging OpsGuru in November to build out the *Content Tagging and Moderation layer*. This layer is what gives us to access to the big AWS discount, so it'd lower our overall cost. In parallel, I'll connect with Ivan to find an ML engineer - in lieu of the pure data scientist - who can help us fine tune Sagemaker models on our own content corpus.

I have communicated to OpsGuru that we're most likely going to defer the proposed engagement - to a future date - just didn't want to completely shut them down in case we come up with some other pathway. Hope & Aaron are having internal discussions so they might come up with alternate plans as well. Given the tight timelines, the logistics may not work out but I'm keeping our options alive.
